name: tizanidine
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypotension: monitor for signs and symptoms of hypotension, in particular in patients receiving concurrent antihypertensives; tizanidine should not be used with other α 2 -adrenergic agonists ( 5.1 , 7.5 ) Risk of liver injury: monitor ALTs; discontinue tizanidine if liver
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Moderate or weak CYP1A2 inhibitors: avoid concomitant use; may cause hypotension, bradycardia, or excessive drowsiness; if concomitant use is necessary and adverse reactions occur, reduce tizanidine dosage or discontinue.
